title: Comparative Assessment of Lipid Layer Thickness Measurements
official: Comparative Assessment of Lipid Layer Thickness Measurements Across Three Devices and Their Correlation With Clinical Indicators in Dry Eye Disease
summary: This study compares ocular lipid layer thickness (LLT) measurements obtained from three commonly used clinical diagnostic devices to evaluate their agreement and consistency. It further examines which device's LLT measurements show the strongest correlation with established clinical indicators of dry eye disease severity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Dry eye disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
